notes.title: Long time no see!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Yesterday i released a new update for [b]GROOD[/b]. Thanks to your feedbacks, i 've added a new keyboard layout (i know, WASD was a little odd for a shoot 'em up).
And, if you miss the tutorial the first time you play, you can now access the controls layout from the [b]options->instructions[/b] menu.

Have a nice one!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32285603/acbee81b9278be9915a4c32a951eafb4cf9c7316.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Co-op mode is live
notes.notes:
Hey guys, if you want to play Grood with a friend, co-op mode is waiting for you!
Player 2 will control [b]"The Companion"[/b], with its three new exclusive weapons.
Enjoy!

notes.title: Chinese localization available!
notes.notes: 大家好! Thanks to the great job of [b]450 studio[/b], GROOD is now available in [b]CHINESE[/b]! So, what are you waiting for? Go Fight Them All!

notes.title: 90's Love Mode available
notes.notes: Hey guys! I've just updated GROOD with the [b]90's Love Mode[/b]! You can find it in the options menu. Go check it out, for old times' sake!

notes.title: GROOD Russian version AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Hey guys,
thanks to [b]Maxim Kabatsky[/b] ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198381893687/]mkabatsky[/url]), GROOD is now available in [b]RUSSIAN[/b]!

So, what are you waiting for? сразитесь со всеми ними!

Have a nice fight!

notes.title: GROOD is available in 3 languages!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
GROOD is now available in English, Italian and... [b]SPANISH[/b]! Russian and Japanese are coming in the next 15 days, followed by Korean.
The game starts using your operating system language by default, but you can always change it from the options.

Cheers!

notes.title: GROOD speaks ITALIANO
notes.notes:
GROOD is getting multilanguage! You can now change language from the options menu.
Right now, the game is available in english and italian.
The following languages are coming in the next couple of weeks:

[list]
    [*]Russian
    [*]Japanese
    [*]Spanish
    [*]Korean
[/list] 

Cheers!

notes.title: New weapon and improvements
notes.notes:
Hey, guys, GROOD just got an update with a new weapon: [b]SHOTGUN[/b]! 
And, based on feedbacks from the community, several other things has been fixed/changed:

[list]
[*] Added a second savegame (now the game saves after each boss fight)
[*] Better overall visibility (especially at night)
[*] Better player lamp
[*] Better visbility for enemy missiles
[*] Difficulty balancing (still hard, don't worry!)
[*] Better power-ups highlights
[*] White screen freeze fixed
[*] Resolution change problem on some monitor fixed
[*] Random window crack after taking damage
[*] Less particles in some situations
[/list]

Bye!
